789-3025-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-3025-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

265-2073-2981--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the Servo.
When the Servo dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat.
265-2073-2981--90.notes: If the artifact can sacrifice itself, you can do so in lieu of sacrificing the artifact to Megatog. Also, if the artifact can tap to produce mana (like Sol Ring) or other products, you can do that as well.

4785-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

687-2034-7888.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one additional counter of any kind on Tayam or an additional creature you control.
687-2034-7888.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fearsome Goblin Pair, adding {C}{C}.
When Fearsome Goblin Pair dies, it creates a creature token with at least three counters on it, including a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing two counters from the creature token and one counter from another creature you control, milling three cards and returning Fearsome Goblin Pair from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Tayam again by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from Fearsome Goblin Pair and two counters from the creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Fearsome Goblin Pair and the creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Fearsome Goblin Pair dies, it creates a creature token with at least three counters on it, including a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Fearsome Goblin Pair from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.
687-2034-7888.notes: This order of operations and the additional {2} starting mana is necessary because you must activate mana abilities like Ashnod's Altar's before paying the counter removal cost.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-4699--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

618-5887-8095.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-6794.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2415-3330.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-3330.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

6824-7855.easyPrerequisites: You control another Goblin, Orc or Army.
6824-7855.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give The Great Goblin lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
6824-7855.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on another Goblin, Orc or Army you control.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 2 life due to its lifelink.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-3921-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Winding Constrictor
Repeat.

2033-7686-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-7686-7730.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-7686-7730.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1451-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Pyreheart Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
1451-2511-6972.notes: If Pyreheart Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-2263-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Repeat.
2034-2263-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4377-6991-7631.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Donnie & April
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

933-1061-7393.easyPrerequisites: You control a Shard that doesn't have summoning sickness.
933-1061-7393.description:
Activate Niko by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Timestream Navigator and causing Shards you control to become a copy of Timestream Navigator until the end step.
Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield. Conjurer's Closet then triggers, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Repeat each turn.

186-2060-5140-7267.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-2060-5140-7267.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2530-2577-6518-7173.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-6518-7173.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

1494-2609-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-2609-4613-7152.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-2609-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Recruit the Worthy. Recruit the Worthy is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

141-5530.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Another Round.
141-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Another Round, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Another Round, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

1829-1894-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

821-2173-5220-5933.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2292-4484-4871-5643-6709.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
2292-4484-4871-5643-6709.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2292-4484-4871-5643-6709.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

4659-5660-6690.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sparring Construct, adding {C}{C}.
When Sparring Construct dies, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sparring Construct from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sparring Construct by paying {1}.
Repeat.

602-6033.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
602-6033.description:
During your cleanup step, discard to your maximum hand size.
Feast of Sanity triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Feast of Sanity trigger.
Repeat from step 2.

224-1359-1683-3257.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
224-1359-1683-3257.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Penance by putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Rakdos Carnarium on top of your library.
Galadriel triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from the top of your library onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

1818-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1818-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2523-5231-5562.notablePrerequisites: Stalwarts of Osgiliath is your Ring-bearer.
2523-5231-5562.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Stalwarts of Osgiliath, adding {R}.
When Stalwarts of Osgiliath dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Stalwarts of Osgiliath that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

647-4053-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
647-4053-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

847-4364.notablePrerequisites:
Creatues you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Gilraen does not have summoning sickness.
847-4364.description:
Declare Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to take an extra combat phase after this one.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat each combat phase.
847-4364.notes: You can perform steps 3 and 4 before combat damage is dealt to ensure Aurelia does not die, or you can do so after damage is dealt but before the combat phase ends to deal combat damage.

1187-2292-2527-2972-4549.notablePrerequisites: Ganax does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1187-2292-2527-2972-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Relic of Legends's second ability by tapping Ganax.
Ganax triggers, causing all Dragons you control to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Relic of Legends ability, untapping it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ganax.
When Ganax dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ganax enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Ion Storm by paying {1}{R} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ganax, dealing two damage to any target.
Repeat.

1385-3644-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Young Wolf does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1385-3644-4929-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Young Wolf.
Zulaport Cutthroat and Young Wolf's undying ability trigger.
Resove the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Young Wolf's undying ability, returning Young Wolf from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Young Wolf, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2645-4747.notablePrerequisites:
Alena does not have summoning sickness.
A creature with power five or greater has entered the battlefield this turn.
2645-4747.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Alena.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
